posts.author: Sergio
posts.content_md:
I guess is usual manufactures state "single mode" on their specification sheet because the line covers a small spectral range due temperature/current variation. Multimode diode lasers will "ooze" into spectrum without mode hoppings?

One fantastic laser would be the Sony DVD: [http://www.sony.net/Products/SC-HP/lase ... d1332v.pdf](http://www.sony.net/Products/SC-HP/laserdiodewld/products/pdf/sld1332v.pdf)

Note the current variation with power without mode hops and the narrow spectrum.

One hope would be the 1 W - green laser in current Holographic Versatile Disc prototype development, if mass produced, since seems a DPSS laser(?).

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: This seems to be a new power level achieved for diodes in SLM. Of course with a cavity this short all of the mode hopping issues would be present.
